limitations: Qualified candidate, not whole-platform production readiness
Offline manual cutover requires every writer stopped; final source drift check is not an online cutover protocol
Original source is stale rollback after first destination write
Baseline starts full-state delivery; legacy operations are never claimed as delivered
No in-place downgrade or automatic startup upgrade
Checksums detect corruption, not authenticated untrusted authority
Full-state event storage and full-history verification retain unqualified growing-store cost
